story.text: This is the story. Listen to it, then tap what you want to do.

combat.text: It is a fight! On your turn, tap a gold square to walk or a card to act, then tap End turn.

sheet.text: This is a hero's sheet. It shows how strong, quick and clever they are, and what they can do.

inventory.text: These are your things. Tap one to use it or give it to a friend.

map.text: This is the map. The Atlas shows the whole realm, and the Story trail shows how far you have come.

guide.text: The Field Guide is a book of everything you have met. Tap a picture to read about it.

world.text: This is what the big screen shows. Tap You at the bottom to get back to your turn.

creation.text: Time to make your hero! Pick who they are, then tap the big button to go on.

card.text: A card is something you can do on your turn. Tap it to do it.

buff.text: A buff is a little boost that wears off. A cost is a little weight that wears off too.

item.text: This is one of your things. Tap it to use it or give it to a friend.

token.text: This is the gear that gives you your moves. Each notch is a rank you earned, and the dots fill up as you do your class's deeds.

join.text: Scan this with your phone or tablet, or type the code in Join a game.

howToPlay.title: The story
howToPlay.text: A grown-up reads the story from the big screen. Listen, then tap what you want to do on your phone.

howToPlay.title: Your turn
howToPlay.text: Your phone tells you when it is your turn. Until then, watch the big screen and cheer for your friends.

howToPlay.title: Rolling
howToPlay.text: Tap the big button to throw the dice. A small number never ends the story, but it can take it somewhere new.

howToPlay.title: Fights
howToPlay.text: Tap a gold square to walk or a card to act, then tap End my turn. Nobody dies in this game.

howToPlay.title: Helping friends
howToPlay.text: If a friend is knocked down, stand next to them and play Help Up. They get right back on their feet.

howToPlay.title: Hearing it
howToPlay.text: Tap the question mark button to hear what a screen is for. Press and hold a card to hear what it is.
